title: Battle of Rathenow
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Rathenow", at revision 1374708426, opens: "The Battle of Rathenow was the first engagement between the forces of Brandenburg-Prussia and Sweden in the Swedish-Brandenburg War." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2237215, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1675 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
